subject: Biology
title: Principles of Inheritance and Variation
summary: Mendel (1856–1863, garden pea) ne inheritance ke laws diye: dominance, segregation aur independent assortment. Monohybrid F₂ ratio 3:1 (phenotype), 1:2:1 (genotype); dihybrid F₂ 9:3:3:1.
Mendel se hatke: incomplete dominance (snapdragon 1:2:1), co-dominance (ABO blood groups), multiple alleles, pleiotropy aur polygenic inheritance (skin colour).

Chromosomal theory of inheritance (Sutton aur Boveri) ne genes ko chromosomes par rakha; Morgan ke Drosophila kaam ne linkage aur recombination dikhaya. Sex determination chromosomes se (XX–XY, XX–XO, ZW–ZZ jaise birds mein) ya haplodiploidy (honey bee) se.

Mutation aur chromosomal badlaav disorders karte hain: Mendelian (haemophilia, colour blindness, sickle-cell anaemia, phenylketonuria, thalassemia) aur chromosomal (Down's, Klinefelter's, Turner's syndromes). Pedigree analysis parivaar mein traits trace karta hai.

formulas.name: Monohybrid cross
formulas.formula: TT × tt → F₁ Tt (all tall);  F₁ selfed → F₂ phenotype 3:1, genotype 1:2:1 (TT : Tt : tt)

formulas.name: Test cross
formulas.formula: F₁ (Tt) × recessive parent (tt) → 1:1 (monohybrid);  dihybrid test cross → 1:1:1:1
formulas.when: Dominant phenotype ka anjaan genotype dhoondhna.

formulas.name: Dihybrid cross
formulas.formula: RRYY × rryy → F₁ RrYy;  F₂ phenotype 9:3:3:1;  9 genotypes;  4 gamete types from F₁
formulas.when: Do characters — law of independent assortment.

formulas.name: General counts
formulas.formula: gametes = 2ⁿ;  F₂ genotypes = 3ⁿ;  F₂ phenotypes (complete dominance) = 2ⁿ  (n = heterozygous gene pairs)

formulas.name: Incomplete dominance
formulas.formula: snapdragon (Antirrhinum): RR red × rr white → Rr pink;  F₂ phenotype = genotype = 1:2:1

formulas.name: Co-dominance and multiple alleles
formulas.formula: ABO: alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ, i;  Iᴬ and Iᴮ co-dominant, both dominant over i;  6 genotypes, 4 phenotypes (A, B, AB, O)

formulas.name: Pleiotropy and polygenic traits
formulas.formula: pleiotropy: one gene, many effects (phenylketonuria);  polygenic: several genes add up (human skin colour, height)

formulas.name: Linkage and recombination
formulas.formula: genes close together on a chromosome are inherited together (linkage);  recombination frequency ∝ distance (Sturtevant used it to map genes);  Morgan: white-eye/yellow-body ~1.3% recombination, white-eye/miniature wing ~37.2%

formulas.name: Sex determination types
formulas.formula: XX–XY: humans, Drosophila (male heterogametic);  XX–XO: grasshopper;  ZW–ZZ: birds (female heterogametic);  haplodiploid: honey bee (males from unfertilised eggs, n = 16; females 2n = 32)

formulas.name: X-linked recessive
formulas.formula: haemophilia, colour blindness;  carrier mother (XᴴXʰ) × normal father → 50% sons affected, 50% daughters carriers
formulas.note: Affected females kam hoti hain — unhe recessive allele ki do copies chahiye.

formulas.name: Autosomal recessive disorders
formulas.formula: sickle-cell anaemia (GAG → GUG, glutamic acid → valine at 6th position of β-globin);  phenylketonuria (no phenylalanine hydroxylase);  thalassemia (α: chromosome 16, β: chromosome 11 — reduced globin synthesis)
formulas.mistake: Thalassemia quantitative problem hai (globin kam banta hai); sickle-cell qualitative (galat globin) — dono ko mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Chromosomal disorders
formulas.formula: Down's syndrome: trisomy 21 (47);  Klinefelter's: 47, XXY (male, gynaecomastia, sterile);  Turner's: 45, X0 (female, sterile, rudimentary ovaries)

formulas.name: Pedigree symbols
formulas.formula: square = male, circle = female, shaded = affected, double line = consanguineous mating

examples.title: Colour-blind beta
examples.problem: Carrier mahila normal aadmi se shaadi karti hai. Bete ke colour blind hone ka chance?
examples.solution: Bete X maa se lete hain: aadhe ko Xᶜ milta hai → 50% bete.

examples.title: Bachchon ka blood group
examples.problem: Maa-baap Iᴬi aur Iᴮi hain. Bachchon ke sambhavit blood groups?
examples.solution: IᴬIᴮ (AB), Iᴬi (A), Iᴮi (B) aur ii (O) — chaaron, har ek ki probability 1/4.

examples.title: Drosophila kyun?
examples.solution: Simple synthetic medium par palta hai, lagbhag do hafte mein life cycle poora, ek mating se bahut offspring, male aur female aasaani se pehchaane jaate hain, aur low-power microscope mein dikhne wale kai hereditary variations.

topics.title: Mendel's experimental design
topics.explain: Mendel ne saat jodi contrasting traits wali 14 true-breeding pea varieties use ki; pea self-pollinating, kam umar wala aur cross karne mein aasaan hai. Bade samples aur statistics use kiye. Unka kaam 1900 mein de Vries, Correns aur von Tschermak ne dobara khoja.

topics.title: Law of dominance and segregation
topics.explain: Characters discrete factors (genes) control karte hain jo jodi mein hote hain; alag jodi mein ek dominate karta hai (dominance). Gamete bante waqt alleles alag hote hain, har gamete ko ek hi milta hai (segregation) — law of purity of gametes.

topics.title: Punnett square
topics.explain: Reginald C. Punnett ka banaya graphical grid jo genetic cross mein offspring ke saare sambhavit genotypes ki probability nikaalta hai.

topics.title: Mutation
topics.explain: DNA sequence mein badlaav jo genotype aur phenotype badalta hai. Point mutation: ek base pair mein badlaav (sickle-cell anaemia). Frameshift mutations: bases ka insertion ya deletion. Mutagens: UV radiation aur chemicals.

topics.title: Chromosomal theory of inheritance
topics.explain: Sutton aur Boveri ne dekha ki chromosomes bhi Mendel ke factors ki tarah jodi mein hote hain, gamete bante waqt alag hote hain aur independently assort hote hain. Sutton ne chromosomal segregation ko Mendelian principles se joda.

topics.title: Aneuploidy and polyploidy
topics.explain: Cell division mein chromatids alag na hone se ek chromosome badhta ya ghatta hai (aneuploidy). Telophase ke baad cytokinesis na hone se poora extra set (polyploidy), plants mein aam.

ratta: Snapdragon 1:2:1 = incomplete dominance;  ABO = co-dominance + multiple alleles.
Grasshopper XO;  birds ZW female;  honey bee haplodiploid.
Down 21 trisomy;  Klinefelter XXY;  Turner XO.
